c.tagline: Silk Road oasis under the Rainbow Mountains.

taxi.fareNote: Metered taxis in town and Didi widely used; the Danxia geopark is ~30 km out, so hire a car or join a tour for that day trip.

emergency.note: 110 reaches police, 120 is for ambulance/medical and 119 is fire.

hood_desc: The walkable heart of Ganzhou around the Ming-era Drum Tower (Zhonglou), with Minzhu Street, the night market, shops and most hotels; the convenient base for first-timers.
The historic quarter around the Giant Buddha Temple (Dafo Si), home to China's largest indoor reclining Buddha and a wooden pagoda; atmospheric and central for sightseeing.
The gateway town near the Zhangye Danxia National Geological Park about 30 km west, where travellers stay to catch sunrise and sunset over the striped Rainbow Mountains; all about the landscape.
The reed-filled Zhangye National Wetland Park on the northern edge of the city, a green, quiet area of boardwalks and birdlife; a calm, local-feeling retreat from the centre.
The newer district around Zhangye West high-speed railway station, with modern hotels and wide avenues; convenient for HSR arrivals but quieter and away from the old core.

water.note: Drink bottled or boiled water, as locals do.

transit.hours: City buses run from about 6:30 AM to 9:00 PM; taxis and Didi fill the late-night gap, and the Danxia geopark needs a car or tour bus.
transit.note: Zhangye has a city bus network and taxis but no metro; the Rainbow Mountains and other Silk Road sights lie outside town and are reached by car, tour or long-distance bus.
transit.pay: Bus fares are paid in cash or by mobile payment (Alipay/WeChat) on board (about 1 yuan); taxis are metered and Didi is widely used.

bus: Zhangye Bus Station — coaches to Jiuquan, Wuwei, Lanzhou and Xining

car.idp: Foreign licences/IDP not valid in China — hire a car with driver for the Danxia geopark

train: Zhangye West Railway Station — Lanzhou–Ürümqi high-speed line; Zhangye Station on the Lanzhou–Xinjiang line

transit.m: Airport shuttle bus to city centre (timed to flights)

tip.r: Tipping is not customary or expected in mainland China; there is no need to tip in restaurants or taxis.
